source_policy: Phebs-authored narrow interpretation of official prose/examples only; no Redis module implementation or metadata bytes are fetched, copied, linked or executed. Newer website features do not broaden the Redis7.2.15 core pin.

common.vector: Complete ordered vector under256elements, every admitted native operand a literal or resolved same-file immutable constant; no format parameters, dynamic suffixes, evaluated options or omitted unknown positions.
common.case: Match command/structural keyword/closed enum tokens using ASCII-only case-insensitive comparison. Preserve all resource/key/prefix/field/label value bytes exactly; no Unicode case folding.
common.strings: Identity/key/prefix/field/label names must be nonempty binary-safe values of at most4096bytes; label values may be empty but share4096byte bound. These are admission limits, not Redis vendor limits.
common.integers: Only canonical ASCII base10 decimal 0 or nonzero digit followed by digits, represented by a Go integer literal or an exact string literal/constant. No sign, leading zeros, hexadecimal, exponent, floating-point, underscore, expression evaluation, overflow or coercion. Check spelling/length/range before conversion.
common.duplicates: Reject repeated named options, vector attribute keys, identical prefixes, field identifiers or TS label names within one vector, even if repeated values agree. Never choose first/last or merge options.
common.failure_order: First require exact receiver/module/import/lexical admission; unsupported client stops as unknown-client-adapter. Then validate the entire native vector before any declaration/schema/reference/catalog delta. An unproved component retains its frozen runtime-namespace/opaque-helper/dynamic-concatenation reason. A fully literal but unknown/unsupported option, enum, bad count/arity/duplicate/range/trailing shape is unsupported-module-command for this named FT/TS subset; this does not assert Redis itself rejects the command. Generic source/budget failure remains zero-blob resource-limit/malformed-input.
common.atomicity: A rejected vector publishes zero native declaration/schema/field/resource-reference facts and mutates no binding catalog prefix. Independent completely proved core usage in the same blob may survive only its own fences. No default/inherited server setting is invented.

FT.CREATE.grammar: FT.CREATE index ON (HASH|JSON) PREFIX count prefix{count} SCHEMA field{1..32}; no omitted ON/PREFIX, no options before/between these sections, no aliases, filters, language/score/temporary/noindex modifiers or unlisted trailing arguments.
FT.CREATE.prefix_count: 1..8, exactly that many following prefix operands, all distinct.
FT.CREATE.ordinary_fields: Each distinct field identifier followed by exactly TEXT, TAG or NUMERIC, with no field options. JSON identifiers remain exact projection strings; no JSONPath evaluator or complete document model.
FT.CREATE.vector_field: field VECTOR FLAT 6 attributes; FLAT only, exactly three mandatory pairs TYPE FLOAT32, DIM dimension, DISTANCE_METRIC metric. Pair order may vary; each appears exactly once. Count6 counts following attribute operands, not pairs; consume exactly6 before another complete schema field or end.
FT.CREATE.dimension: 1..4096, engineering admission only. DIM0/outside-bound/unknown literal are not accepted. HNSW/SVS-VAMANA/other types/optional attributes remain unsupported-module-command in this spike.
FT.CREATE.output: One index plus its complete admitted indexed projection/prefixes, never complete values or data-field schema beyond that projection.

TS.CREATE.grammar: TS.CREATE key [RETENTION milliseconds] [LABELS label value ...]; RETENTION at most once and before LABELS. LABELS, when present, consumes exactly1..8pairs to end, all distinct label names. Key-only and omitted RETENTION are admitted as unspecified retention, never inferred global/default0.
TS.CREATE.retention: 0..2147483647 milliseconds, engineering admission only; literal0 explicitly records no-expiry retention intent as documented, not runtime state.
TS.CREATE.unsupported: ENCODING, CHUNK_SIZE, DUPLICATE_POLICY, IGNORE, odd label arity, duplicate labels/RETENTION, reversed sections and any unlisted options/trailing operands refuse atomically.
TS.CREATE.output: One series resource with only supplied retention/labels; no sample/entry fields or existence/type claim.

TS.CREATERULE.grammar: TS.CREATERULE source destination AGGREGATION aggregator bucket; exactly6operands including command, source and destination nonempty and byte-distinct; no alignment timestamp or trailing options.
TS.CREATERULE.bucket: 1..2147483647 milliseconds, engineering admission only. All other aggregators (including otherwise documented Redis choices), zero/negative/outside-bound/unknown bucket and optional alignment refuse atomically.
TS.CREATERULE.output: One explicit rule with both resource references and supplied aggregation/bucket; no live source/destination validation or propagation.

public_oracle: Unchanged2FT.CREATE source sites remain nearest-modulev9.7.0 unknown-client-adapter,0admitted/atomic-complete. RuntimeDIM remains independently unproved. Narrowing named literal shapes before any recognition changes no public label/denominator.
qualification: Prospective source contract only; this artifact neither validates Redis/server syntax nor grants a quality/adoption result.
